scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:schema && pnpm check:api && pnpm check:instance && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/app/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/content/tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/local/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.check:schema: python3 docs/spec/checks/query_plans.py && python3 docs/spec/checks/integrity.py && python3 scripts/check_migrations.py
scripts.build: pnpm build:ui && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .build/app -c wrangler.app.dev.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .build/content -c wrangler.content.dev.jsonc
